overview.en:
Connect Plaid’s official Dashboard MCP for production integration diagnostics, Link conversion analysis and usage metrics.

Investigate Plaid integration health and Link conversion through the connected Dashboard tools. Keep environment and integration context explicit.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
连接 Plaid 官方 Dashboard MCP，诊断生产集成、分析 Link 转化并查询使用指标。

通过已连接 Dashboard 工具调查 Plaid 集成健康度与 Link 转化，明确环境与集成背景。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Investigate this Plaid integration issue using the available diagnostics.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 使用可用诊断调查这个 Plaid 集成问题。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize the available Link conversion metrics for this period.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这个周期的可用 Link 转化指标。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare an integration health review with usage evidence.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 准备集成健康度审查，并附上用量依据。
